title: Savory Redcurrant Skewers
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring sweet redcurrants paired with savory German-style pork and onions, served on wooden skewers.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine the diced pork, redcurrant, onion, and vivid salt. Mix well.
3. Thread the pork and redcurrant mixture onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through and the redcurrant is tender.
